data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2357 reported negligible prior-year reserve movement for 2015. Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were nil (prior year closing balance), and the year-end gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 was a small $17,000. No material prior-year strengthening or release is recorded or described in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: The amount included in respect of IBNR is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by external consulting actuaries.

Accordingly, the two most critical assumptions as regards claims provisions are that the past is a reasonable predictor of the likely level of claims development and that the rating and other models used for current business are fair reflections of the likely level of ultimate claims to be incurred.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
Other key circumstances affecting the reliability of assumptions include variation in interest rates, delays in settlement and changes in foreign currency rates.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding prior-year column is recorded as nil). No explicit gross prior-year movement (Movement in prior years) is provided in the notes; the claims development table contains only 2015 activity (17,000) and provides no multi-year development for older years. Therefore prior-year development is assessed as nil. Amounts are reported in the report's functional currency (USD). Exact reserve-movement narrative for prior years was not found.
